description: Guided Corruption / Mutation flow: pure React-free reducer under src/logic/guided-corruption/, a portal overlay GuidedCorruptionPanel + opt-in GuidedCorruptionTrigger, and host wiring inside CorruptionCard (including a NEW optional onRoll prop). Mirrors the same guided-flow pattern FEAT-001 establishes. Strictly additive: the CorruptionCard in-card mutation roller, Corruption/Sin trackers, and mutation lists stay unchanged; the only new default-render DOM is exactly one trigger. Independent of FEAT-001 (separate new module); build it second so it reuses the exact seeded-RollDialog + tooltip + yield patterns proven in FEAT-001. Mutation d100s stay on the existing roller via a close-and-return hand-off (never RollDialog).
steps: Create src/logic/guided-corruption/types.ts: CorruptionStep = 'threshold' | 'resistance' | 'mutation'; CorruptionFlowState { step: CorruptionStep }; CorruptionFlowEvent = {kind:'start'} | {kind:'next'} | {kind:'back'} | {kind:'goto';step:CorruptionStep} | {kind:'reset'}; CorruptionStepInfo { step; title; body; citation }; CorruptionAdvisorSource.describe(step, ctx:{atOrOverThreshold:boolean}): CorruptionStepInfo | Promise<CorruptionStepInfo>. React-free, JSON-serializable. Header comment cites Core p.183 (+ Pure Soul p.142).

Create src/logic/guided-corruption/reducer.ts mirroring guided-cast/reducer.ts: export STEP_SEQUENCE = ['threshold','resistance','mutation'] as const; initialCorruptionFlowState = { step:'threshold' }; guidedCorruptionReducer(state, event) with the same purity/totality/clamp/no-wrap/frozen-safe rules; start -> { step:'threshold' }; next/back clamp; goto jumps; reset -> fresh initial; default guard. Fixed 3-step sequence, no filtering, no auto-advance.

Create src/logic/guided-corruption/steps.ts: describeCorruptionStep(step, ctx) with static // Core p.183 cited prose for threshold / resistance / mutation; Step-1 copy states the rulebook 'more than' wording vs the app's >= behaviour (A-1/A-4) and cites Pure Soul p.142; export const defaultCorruptionAdvisor: CorruptionAdvisorSource = { describe: describeCorruptionStep }.

Add src/logic/guided-corruption/__tests__/reducer.test.ts and reducer.property.test.ts mirroring FEAT-001's tests, adapted to the 3 steps threshold->resistance->mutation (no diseaseId): unit (start->threshold; next/back order+clamp; goto; reset fresh) and property (step always in STEP_SEQUENCE; nav in-sequence+clamped; boundary no-ops reference-identical; reset deep-equals initial; determinism; frozen-state safety).

Create src/components/shared/GuidedCorruptionTrigger.tsx (+ .module.css) mirroring GuidedCastTrigger: native <button>, lucide Compass icon (NOT Skull/Bug, both already used in CorruptionCard), 'Guide me through this' / icon-only on mobile, aria-label='Guide me through corruption', data-testid='guided-corruption-trigger'; onClick calls e.stopPropagation() then onOpen() (onOpen: ()=>void).

Create src/components/shared/GuidedCorruptionPanel.tsx (+ .module.css copied from GuidedCastPanel.module.css structure) with the same portal/a11y/stepper/live-region/yield scaffold. Consume defaultCorruptionAdvisor. Props: character, state, dispatch, onSeedRoll({name,def,difficulty}), onClose. Step bodies: Step1 Threshold — corr / getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents)) with the 'more than vs >=' note, cite Core p.183; Step2 Resistance — one-tap onSeedRoll for a Challenging (+0) Endurance test with def {kind:'skill',skillName:'Endurance',fallbackChar:'T'}, difficulty 'Challenging', name 'Endurance (resist Corruption)'; guidance that fail=mutation, pass=no mutation this time; Step3 Mutation — guidance + a hand-off button that calls onClose() so the player uses the existing CorruptionCard roller (show type distribution via getMutationTypeDistribution with the Human-fallback note for edge species A-6, limits getPhysicalMutationLimit/getMentalMutationLimit, WPB loss getCorruptionLossOnMutation); seed NO RollDialog for the d100s; never call the card's roller handlers. No math, no mutation.

Add calculated-total tooltips to GuidedCorruptionPanel (calculated-totals steering, FR-6): single openTooltipId + anchor state; render each total via TooltipTriggerCell + Tooltip — corruption threshold via a small local helper building ['TB '+getBonus(T), 'WPB '+getBonus(WP), 'Pure Soul '+getPureSoulLevel(talents)] with the total from getCorruptionThreshold (Finding 8: the assistant rule's lines are a local literal, not an exported builder, so build an identically-sourced local helper, do not import from the rule); physical/mental mutation limits (getPhysicalMutationLimit/getMentalMutationLimit) and corruption-loss-on-mutation (getCorruptionLossOnMutation) with TB/WPB component lines. No number recomputed by hand.

Host the guide in src/components/shared/CorruptionCard.tsx (additive) and add an optional onRoll?: (r: RollResult) => void prop to CorruptionCardProps (optional so existing callers/tests stay green, NFR-2 — Finding 1). Add useReducer(guidedCorruptionReducer, initialCorruptionFlowState), a guideOpen flag, and rollDialogState:{name;baseTarget;difficulty}|null. Render exactly one GuidedCorruptionTrigger near the Corruption Tracker section; onOpen=()=>{ setGuideOpen(true); dispatchGuide({kind:'start'}); }. Render GuidedCorruptionPanel only when guideOpen AND rollDialogState==null (yield). Step-2 onSeedRoll seeds the Endurance RollDialog via resolveSeededTarget; onRoll=(r)=>{ onRoll?.(r); setRollDialogState(null); }. Step-3 hand-off closes the guide. Close dispatches reset + clears guideOpen + restores focus. Do NOT change the existing roller/trackers/lists.
Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedCorruptionTrigger.test.tsx (mirror GuidedCastTrigger.test.tsx): button renders with data-testid/aria-label; onClick calls onOpen; stopPropagation holds.

Add src/components/shared/__tests__/GuidedCorruptionPanel.steps.test.tsx and GuidedCorruptionPanel.integration.test.tsx (RTL). Cover: CorruptionCard renders exactly one guided-corruption-trigger; opens at Step 1 (AC-3); order threshold->resistance->mutation (AC-10); Step 1 shows corr / getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents)) and cites Core p.183 (AC-11); Step 2 opens a RollDialog seeded Challenging (+0) Endurance via the reminder seam, the guide does not read the result, and with an onRoll spy passed to CorruptionCard rolling fires onRoll with the result while mutating no character field (Finding 1, AC-12); Step 3 opens no RollDialog for the d100 and its hand-off button closes the guide (AC-13); tooltips (AC-14) — the corruption-threshold Tooltip contains TB/WPB/Pure Soul lines and the mutation-limit/loss tooltips show their components; no-auto invariants (AC-15) — mount, Next/Back, open a seeded roll, and roll never call updateCharacter with a mutation and never auto-advance; modal + a11y parity (AC-18/19).
acceptance_criteria: guidedCorruptionReducer is pure, total, frozen-state-safe, and reset from any state deep-equals initialCorruptionFlowState (fast-check property tests).
With the guide closed, CorruptionCard renders identically to today apart from exactly one guided-corruption-trigger, and all pre-existing CorruptionCard tests pass UNCHANGED.
Activating the corruption trigger opens the overlay at Step 1; Esc/backdrop/close return focus to the trigger.
The flow presents exactly, in order: Threshold check, Resistance test, Mutation resolution; Step 1 shows corr / getCorruptionThreshold(chars, getPureSoulLevel(talents)) and cites Core p.183.
Step 2 opens a RollDialog seeded Challenging (+0) Endurance via resolveSeededTarget; with an onRoll spy, rolling fires onRoll and mutates no character field; the guide does not interpret the result.
Step 3 opens no RollDialog for the mutation d100 and its hand-off button closes the guide so the player uses the existing in-card roller + Add to Character.
Every calculated total (threshold, physical/mental mutation limit, corruption-loss-on-mutation) renders a Tooltip breakdown with additive components.
The guide never mutates the character, never rolls, never advances a step, and never marks a step complete on its own.
npx tsc --build --force --noEmit is clean and npm run build compiles.
